intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lebanon for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 7 (The Dancing Lights of Christmas) through January 3, 2027, with A Very Merry 1930s Christmas at Sadie Ford Heritage Farm (November 28), Dolly Days of Christmas parade (December 6), Christmas on the Square (December 12) and the 32nd Annual Christmas Toy Train Show (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Lebanon

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Lebanon
  • 4 free events, including the Sadie Ford Heritage Farm Christmas, free photos with Santa at 3:Sixteen Boutique, the Dolly Days parade and Christmas on the Square
  • Meet Santa: Sadie Ford Heritage Farm (November 28) and 3:Sixteen Boutique (November 29)
  • Parades: Dolly Days of Christmas parade (December 6)
  • Trains: the 32nd Annual Christmas Toy Train Show (December 12)
  • Season: November 7, 2026 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Lebanon families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Nashville, which covers ICE at Gaylord Opryland, Glow Wild at Nashville Zoo, Holiday LIGHTS at Cheekwood and the Santa Express train at Tennessee Central Railway Museum.
